graph_team_stat_off_sack_rate_on_product.notes:
Paired candidate(weak_stack_graph_sack)-minus-baseline(weak_stack) on 749 games, 51 weeks, close-graded 2014-2016 (rotation family graph_off_sack_rate_on_production, inherits graph_ratings_v2_team_stat so it could not re-draw the already-spent 2011-2013 block). Candidate accuracy 50.07% vs baseline 51.00%. Week-blocked 95% CI [-2.625,+0.809] pts, P+ 0.122; season-blocked 95% CI [-2.419,+1.992], P+ 0.248. Home-pick rate baseline 37.6% vs candidate 36.7% (close together, so little home-tilt artifact here, unlike the bare-baseline screen's 55-67% arms). Within-week permutation null (200 perms) centres at +0.416 pts, sd 0.940; observed -0.935 sits at the 6.0th percentile of its own null -- a mild negative lean, not a resolved wrong sign at either blocking. Positive control (candidate column replaced by realized ats_margin) showed +48.999 pts, P+ 1.000, proving the full-profile ridge harness is not blind. Null check (200 perms, real margins) produced a sane distribution (mean +0.416, sd 0.940). NOT commensurable with the graph_ratings_v2_team_stat family's own bare-market-baseline entries (different comparator: production chain vs zero-feature baseline) -- recorded under a separate family on purpose, per AGENTS.md's pooling-commensurability rule. CLOSE-graded: settles no play/no-play decision. Predeclared in docs/graph_team_stat_on_production.md before any outcome was scored.
